Mtengo Wokana Kufa

Kuphatikiza pa Mapiri, Moyo Umakhala ndi Njira.

Kodi ngati chiwonetsero chachikulu cha chiyembekezo sichingakhale chikumbutso chopangidwa ndi anthu, koma chitsamba chokhala ndi moyo chomwe chikanakana kuvomereza?

Imagine a city that has lost its voice. Buildings have fallen, streets have disappeared under the rubble, and traces of human life seem to have faded into silence. Yet, in the very heart of this forgotten place, one extraordinary tree continues to live.

Masamba ake samangofuna nthaka. Amafika m'mphepete mwa zitseko zowonongeka, amakumbatira zigawo zowonongeka, komanso amayenda pakati pa zipinda zogawidwa, kusinthira kuwonongeka kukhala kulumikizana. Masamba ake amatsika kumwamba, akunyamula masamba obiriwira obiriwira pansi pa mwanga wagolide womwe umagwa m'makutu.

Izi ndi zambiri kuposa chithunzi cha chilengedwe chofunanso kubwezeretsa mzinda wowonongeka. Ndi nkhani yokhudza kwambiri za mzimu wa munthu.

Mtengowu umaimira aliyense amene wakumana ndi mavuto osalola kuti mavuto awa afotokozere nthawi yawo yatsogolo. Amalankhula kwa iwo omwe akusowapo zonse, komabe amapeza mphamvu yoyambanso. Kwa iwo omwe akhumudwa ndi moyo, koma sanalole kuti mtima wawo ukhale wopanda pake. Kwa iwo omwe amamvetsetsa kuti kupulumuka sikungokhala ndi moyo, koma kupeza mphamvu yowonjezereka.

Masamba ake amaimira kulimbana: mphamvu yosaoneka yomwe imatiteteza pamene zinthu zonse m'malo athu zimagwa pansi. Mapiri awo amaimira kugwirizana, kulumikizana, komanso mwayi wobwezeretsa ubale ndi mabungwe pambuyo pa kugawidwa ndi kuwonongeka.

Mtundu wa mitengo yachinyezi ndi lonjezo lakuti kuwononga sichiyenera kukhala gawo lachiwiri. Maphikidwe a mbalame zoyenda m'nyanja amakumbutsa kuti ufulu ndi kubwezeretsa kungachitike, ngakhale pambuyo pa nthawi yoyera kwambiri.

Ndipo mwanga wagolide m’mbali mwa mapiriwa umapatsa uthenga wolimba mtima koma wothandiza: chiyembekezo sichidzasankhidwa ndi zimene zawonongedwa, koma ndi zimene zilibe chikhulupiriro chokhala ndi chikhulupiriro.
